title: Port the CI-gated close-out and PR-posted review to the Workflow reconciler
description:
epic-reconciler.ts has no CI wait, no hold on red naming the job, no refusal on absent CI, and posts neither verdict nor findings on the PR. A closeout job reporting done is closed like an implement tick.

The Go admitCloseout (internal/reconcile/dispatch.go) has no TypeScript counterpart, so the repository's own PR + CI rule — the one .tick/config.md declares and the Go side refuses to run without — is simply absent on the Cloudflare host.

Note the shape of the Go fix before porting: 9da's closeout_ci.go had to re-read the PR and walk ancestors past run-state-only commits, because the act of gating rewrites the thing being gated. The port needs that too, or it deadlocks the same way Phase 3 did.

From pxc, finding 5c906cc7.
acceptance_criteria: A Workflow-hosted close-out refuses to complete without green CI on the epic PR, names the failing job on red, and the PR carries the review's verdict and findings
